description: Craggy hills with strata in various shades of brown roll across the composition. Smaller green hills ripple below the brown ones. A pale gray sky stretches above. The white edge of the exposed paper surrounds the scene.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
title: Untitled (Ghost Ranch Landscape)
